property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always propagates a failing low-level call (to transferFrom) as a revert (i.e., the call either succeeds for every callee invocation or the whole transfer() reverts); the mutant that removes require(_s) allows transfer(...) to return true even when the external call fails, which this test detects by providing a callee that can be toggled to fail.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so failures of the call no longer revert the function (behavior differs when caddress.call returns false).
